title: Extinction Resource Guide, Best Resource Locations, Ark Survival Ascended
description:
Resources are the cornerstone of survival in every Ark. In this guide, I’ll show you the best locations for every crucial resource you’ll need to thrive on Extinction. Whether you’re looking for basics like stone and flint, or rare materials like black pearls and corrupted wood, this video has got you covered!

Resources Covered in This Guide:
0:00-0:14 Intro
0:15-0:32 Oil
0:33-0:54 Organic Polymer/Polymer/Corrupted Nodules
0:53: 1:10 Honey
1:11-1:39 Cementing Paste & Bio Toxin
1:40-1:54 Rare Mushrooms/Rare Flowers & Silk
1:55-2:13 Sap     
2:14-2:46 Obsidian & Black Pearls
2:47-3:05 Condensed Gas/Sulfur
3:06-3:26 Green Gems/Crystalized Sap
3:27-3:42 Silicate & Silicia Pearls
3:43-4:06 Metal & Scrap Metal
4:07-4:26: Crystal
4:27-4:48: Element & Element Dust: 
4:49-5:58: Basic Resources &Final Great Locations

Special Note: Most resources can be passively produced by Gachas, but some (like Honey, Rare Flowers, Rare Mushrooms, Cementing Paste, and Chitin) require manual collection.

Every map brings new challenges, and Extinction is no exception. Which resource has given you the most trouble on this map? Let me know in the comments! Or, if you have a tip, share it to help your fellow survivors.

If you enjoyed this guide, don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more in-depth ARK content.
